title: Bolus calc : if pump gives error, the carbs are not registered
symptom: When using the bolus calculator, if the pump gives an error (e.g., daily insulin limit alert) during insulin delivery, the carbs are not registered even though some insulin was given and correctly registered.
cause: The behavior is by design to prevent double carbs entry on a second try.
fix: No fix provided; the maintainer states that there is a message to check insulin and carbs, implying the user should manually verify.
evidence_quote: this is by design to prevent double carbs entry on 2nd try
